product_job: Say what is true today: what can be spent, what is coming, and what just moved.
emotional_role: Open, brighter, lived-in, daily, more active than setup.
spatial_metaphor: A morning room already in use. Not the front door.
architectural_character: A lived room with a wide day opening. Not the entry arch, not the bust, not the bowl-and-book still life.
lighting_character: Brighter, higher day light than the setup desk.
material_emphasis: Warm plaster, a used textile, paper. Stone stays in the world, not as the hero.
environmental_focal_point: Daylight and an ordinary daily object. Not a portrait bust.
object_language: Something handled today: a folded cloth, a single cup, or an open note. Not the arrival stack of books.
botanical_role: A small sprig or a shadow of leaves. Not the entry olive framing the bust.
negative_space_strategy: The left and center-left stay clear for the safe-to-spend figure. The right of the room breathes.
composition_bias: The number leads. The room sits behind it.
information_density: One authoritative figure, then two short groups: coming, and moved.
panel_behavior: Coming and moved are one journal surface, not a stack of bank cards.
data_visualization_character: A single computed figure. No chart, no sparkline, no account balance costume.
interaction_character: See why, ask, and add. Depth belongs to later families.
motion_character: The figure is still. Sheets rise over the room. No counting animation.
typographic_character: The safe-to-spend figure is the display moment. Labels stay small.
relationship_to_previous_family: After the desk. A more active hour in the same house. Not another view of the arrival doorway.
relationship_to_next_family: Activity is the quieter record of what today only previews.
family_specific_traits: Coming and moved as one journal
